Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.0 MSE & Start-up Exemption for Turnover: Yes (i.e For MSE / Start-up bidders, relaxation of 20% on financ ial criteria of MAAT (bidder turnover) is considered i.e. an MSE / Start-up bidder meeting 80% of MAAT (bid der turnover) requirement for this package shall be considered qualified on this aspect). 2.0 MSE & Start-up Exemption of Experience Criteria: Yes (i.e For MSE / Start-up bidders, relaxation of 20% on experience criteria (financially) is considered i.e. an MSE / Start-up bidder meeting 80% of experience cr iteria (financially) requirement for this package shall be considered qualified on this aspect). 3.0 GRID-INDIA reserves the right to relax/waive-off minor deviations with respect to QR as stipulated in th e bid document, the decision of GRID-INDIA in this regard shall be final & binding on bidders. 4.0 Bidders need to submit the documents uploaded in 'Buyer uploaded ATC document' clause of bid docu ment.

5.0 Quantity Variation: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantities of items un der the contract but without any change in unit price or other terms and conditions. Such variation shall n ot be subjected to any limitations for the individual items but the total variation in all such items under the contract shall be limited to +/- 25 % (plus/minus twenty-five percent) of the total contract price. Bidders ar e bound to accept the orders accordingly. 6.0 The bidder must ensure that the OEM of the supplied Multi-Function Printers has a functional service ce nter at both Guwahati and Shillong, at least for the past 05 years. Bidder must submit proof of the same d uring the bid submission process. 7.0 The OEM for Multi-Function Printers must be in business for at least 10 years in India. Documentary evi dence has to be enclosed in the bid. 8.0 Bidder must submit the Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) for the offered Multi-Function Printers with all other required documents during the bid submission process. 9.0 All hardware shall be new and suitable for the purposes specified and shall be of reputed make as spec ified. 10.0 The colour cartridge sets supplied in this bid should be original, same make as printer OEM, compatibl e with the supplied printer and must match the technical requirements. Third-party compatible cartridges will be treated as non-compliant. 11.0 The complete scope of supply includes Multi-Function Printers (1 Monochrome and 2 Colour pr inters) and 2 sets of OEM-make colour cartridges (Set of Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Black Cartrid ges) along with the printers. The bidder shall ensure that the quoted price for each Multi-Func tion colour Printers includes the cost of the printer along with OEM-make colour cartridges (Se t of 01 Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Black Cartridge each). 12.0 Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not con tain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due t o activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 13.0 Signed Scope of Work and Technical Specifications should be submitted by the bidder during bidding . 14.0 In case of any overlap between the GeM terms & conditions and the terms of the Additional Scope of Work, then the terms of the Additional Scope of Work shall hold precedence. . 6. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 7. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address

NERLDC Shillong GRID INDIA POWERGRID Complex Lapalang Shillong, Meghalaya- 793006 NERLDC Guwahati GRID INDIA Kahilipara, Guwahati, Assam-781019 . 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
